**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or inducement covenant binding Customer — confirmed by searches for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "employee", and "personnel" and by reading the General, Customer Responsibilities, Confidentiality, and Compliance sections. § 12.3 affirmatively preserves our right to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and records that we gave no no-hire commitment. No redline required.
